verse.verse_1: By those that winnow with a winnowing
verse.verse_2: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
verse.verse_3: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
verse.verse_4: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
verse.verse_5: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
verse.verse_6: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
verse.verse_7: By the heaven full of paths,
verse.verse_8: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
verse.verse_9: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
verse.verse_11: Who are careless in an abyss!
verse.verse_12: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
verse.verse_13: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
verse.verse_14: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
verse.verse_15: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
verse.verse_16: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
verse.verse_17: They used to sleep but little of the night,
verse.verse_18: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
verse.verse_19: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
verse.verse_20: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
verse.verse_21: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
verse.verse_22: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
verse.verse_23: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
verse.verse_24: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
verse.verse_25: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
verse.verse_26: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
verse.verse_27: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
verse.verse_28: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
verse.verse_29: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
verse.verse_30: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
verse.verse_31: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
verse.verse_32: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
verse.verse_33: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
verse.verse_34: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
verse.verse_35: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
verse.verse_36: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
verse.verse_37: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
verse.verse_38: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
verse.verse_39: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
verse.verse_40: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
verse.verse_41: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
verse.verse_42: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
verse.verse_43: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
verse.verse_44: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
verse.verse_45: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
verse.verse_46: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
verse.verse_47: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
verse.verse_48: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
verse.verse_49: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
verse.verse_50: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
verse.verse_51: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
verse.verse_52: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
verse.verse_53: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.
verse.verse_54: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
verse.verse_55: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
verse.verse_56: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
verse.verse_57: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
verse.verse_58: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
verse.verse_59: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
verse.verse_60: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
